claim_text: #### Strand 2: Provenance and Cryptographic Verification The project puts significant emphasis on provenance tracking and cryptographic verification: - `src/yanantin/provenance/timestamp.py` - Timestamp functionality - `docs/ots/` directory contains thousands of OpenTimestamps (OTS) files - `.claude/hooks/ots_stamp.py` - Hook for timestamping - `docs/signing.md` - Documentation on signing process This suggests a strong focus on verifiability and auditability of AI-generated content, ensuring that the provenance of observations can be cryptographically proven.
